UnRAR 7.3.1 source, from https://www.rarlab.com/rar/unrarsrc-7.3.1.tar.gz

Two local changes, both behind macros defined by the loader's build:

  os.hpp          RAR_SMP is not defined when SF6_LOADER_NO_SMP is set. The loader runs
                  inside DllMain, under the loader lock; unrar's multi-threaded unpacker
                  would wait on worker threads that can never start, and hang the game.
  secpassword.cpp SecHideData does not LoadLibrary(Crypt32.dll) when SF6_LOADER_NO_CRYPT32
                  is set, and falls back to unrar's own obfuscation. Loading a library
                  from DllMain is unsafe. The loader never supplies passwords anyway.

UnRAR source code may be used in any software to handle RAR archives without
limitations free of charge, but cannot be used to develop RAR (WinRAR) compatible
archiver and to re-create RAR compression algorithm, which is proprietary.
Distribution of modified UnRAR source code in separate form or as a part of other
software is permitted, provided that full text of this paragraph, starting from
"UnRAR source code" words, is included in license, or in documentation if license
is not available, and in source code comments of resulting package.
